questions.q: What principle says word forms are unrelated to their meanings?
questions.why: Mentions arbitrariness as first core principle.

questions.q: According to Pinker, why can children master grammar without formal study?
questions.why: States poverty of stimulus explains grammar acquisition.

questions.q: Which linguist is called the father of modern linguistics in the book?
What does Pinker contrast with prescriptive rules?
questions.why: Describes descriptive rules as describing actual speech.

questions.q: How does Pinker describe language's efficiency?
questions.why: Lists infinite use of finite media as second core principle.
